name: task-primer
description: A resident work-delegation application: worker sub-process controlled via CLI flags, REST API, and browser UI.

notes: Chrome for Testing — pinned, never auto-updates.
Provides a frameless --app window whose process is a direct child
of main.js, enabling reliable exit detection via ChildProcess events.
To update: change buildId to a new build from
then delete .browsers/ so the new build is downloaded on next --ui run.
